annotations.content: **p-smooth number**: n > 0 with all prime factors ≤ p. The 3-smooth numbers are {1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 12, ...} — exactly the degrees constructible with single-fold origami.
**k-fold origami constructibility**: degree d is k-fold constructible iff d is p_{k+1}-smooth. Each fold level adds one prime to the constructible set.
**Strict hierarchy**: Each fold level is strictly more powerful than the previous, witnessed by the separating prime p_{k+2}.
**Monotonicity**: k-fold ⊆ (k+1)-fold. Uses the strict monotonicity of the prime sequence.
**Algebraic completeness**: Every d > 0 is k-fold constructible for some k. Uses p_n ≥ n+2 to ensure all prime factors of d fall below the prime bound.
